extra.name: Surveillance Spotter
extra.author: aedilis
extra.description: Flags Flock ALPR cameras and surveillance gear in your wardrive, with GPS.
extra.about: Watches the networks your WiFi wardrive collects and flags Flock Safety ALPR cameras and related surveillance hardware, with the GPS position of each sighting. Detection is tiered because a vendor MAC prefix alone is not proof of a camera: CONFIRMED = the SSID names the device (Flock, Flock-XXXXXX, Penguin, Pigvision, FS Ext Battery); SUSPECT = a MAC prefix tied to Flock hardware; KEYWORD = an SSID containing one of your own watch words; WEAK = contract-manufacturer prefixes (Liteon, Silicon Labs, USI) that also appear on lots of unrelated devices, hidden unless you turn them on. Known look-alikes (ClickShare, WiFi-Direct printers, Android hotspots, other detectors' 'Flock ALPR' output) are excluded first. New hits pop a large alert and are logged to the game terminal. Every sighting is remembered across sessions (first/last seen, times seen, and the last position a GPS fix was available, with the time it was taken), so you can track devices over time. Positions are only taken when a network first shows up while this screen is open; networks that were already in the wardrive list when you open it are logged as backlog without a position, and are never re-counted or moved. Keys: [K] add a watch word, [X] remove the last one, [W] toggle weak vendor matches, [E] export all sightings as CSV to loot/extras/surveillance_spotter/ (text that a spreadsheet would run as a formula is neutralised), [C] clear the session list, [UP]/[DOWN] scroll. Needs a running WiFi wardrive; GPS is optional (hits without a fix are logged without a position). Passive only: it reads what your scan already collected and transmits nothing.
